note.zh: 使用 cases.json 中的标准中文提示词，在隔离的裸 Codex CLI 中以 GPT-6 Astra（xhigh）一次启动，未加载额外 skill、插件或 MCP，也未使用自定义系统提示。模型在同一次 CLI 运行中创建 Vite 项目、生成并构建独立的单文件 index.html，并执行单元、离线单文件和浏览器实际交互检查后完成修复；没有人工修改代码。提交文件是该运行生成的独立 HTML，仅按仓库规范无内容改动地复制为 mythos-craft.html，Vite 外壳、依赖和检查缓存未提交。
note.en: Started once from the canonical Chinese prompt in cases.json using GPT-6 Astra (xhigh effort) in an isolated bare Codex CLI; no additional skills, plugins, or MCP servers were loaded, and no custom system prompt was used. Within the same CLI run, the model created a Vite project, generated and built a standalone single-file index.html, and ran unit, offline single-file, and real browser interaction checks before completing its fixes; no human code edits were made. The submitted file is that standalone HTML, copied without content changes to the repository's canonical name mythos-craft.html; the Vite shell, dependencies, and check cache are not included.
